name: ComfortRide Baby Stroller Deluxe
description: Premium baby stroller with a reversible seat, adjustable canopy, and one-click fold mechanism. Features a large storage basket, all-terrain wheels, and a padded seat for maximum comfort.
shortDescription: Premium reversible-seat baby stroller with all-terrain wheels.

name: LightFold Baby Stroller Compact
description: Lightweight baby stroller designed for urban parents on the go. Ultra-compact fold fits in any car trunk, with a UV-protective canopy, reclining seat, and easy-steer swivel wheels.
shortDescription: Ultra-lightweight compact baby stroller for city use.
